findings.observation: Bash MCP memory wrapper wired by .mcp.json never discovers .venv-win; on native Windows Git Bash with no python3 and no .venv/bin/python it would exit 69 when BIOETL_AI_MEMORY_MODE=read-write even though .venv-win exists.
findings.method: read wrapper; Git Bash interpreter probe; compare mcp_memory_wrapper.ps1 and run_workflow.sh
findings.expected: .venv-win/Scripts/python.exe selected on native Windows when POSIX venv is absent, matching AGENTS.md and #9121
findings.actual: order was BIOETL_WSL_VENV_DIR, .venv/bin/python, python3, else exit 69. Probe: venv-win YES, venv/bin NO, python3 NONE, PICK=NONE
findings.impact: Windows operators cannot start the documented MCP memory server from canonical .mcp.json after enabling read-write.
findings.root_cause: #9121 fixed run_workflow.sh only; architecture test asserted .venv-win solely on the unused-by-.mcp.json PowerShell wrapper.
findings.remediation: Add .venv-win after POSIX .venv/bin/python; extend architecture assertion.

evidence.observation: PICK=NONE before fix; PICK=.venv-win after fix
